To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
co-ingestion of tea with a high-quality protein food (eg, egg) reduces protein digestibility in humans.
co-ingestion of tea with high quality protein (whole egg protein) reduces protein digestibility.
co-ingestion of tea reduces the indispensable amino acid digestibility of hens’ eggs in Indian adults.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of black tea on protein digestibility in Indian adults, using a dual-isotope tracer approach.
the impact of black tea on protein digestibility of a whole egg meal.
the effect of tea polyphenol on protein digestion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the consumption of tea with a protein meal reduces the digestibility of high-quality protein, and this may be of particular relevance to populations at risk of inadequate dietary protein intake.
the co-ingestion of tea with a high quality protein food (eggs) reduced the true indispensable amino acids (IAA) of the food by ~17% in healthy Indian adults.
black tea consumption with a meal reduces the digestibility of high quality proteins in healthy Indian adults.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the co-ingestion of a commonly consumed beverage like tea with a high-quality protein source like egg protein can reduce protein digestibility.
black tea consumption with meals containing a good quality protein source can reduce the true IAA availability of the protein.
tea consumption during or after the meal can reduce the bioavailability of protein in the diet and hence the risk of protein inadequacy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the consumption of tea with meals, which is common in India, can reduce the true IAA availability from high-quality proteins such as eggs.
tea consumption can reduce the digestibility of egg protein, and hence, the bioavailability of indispensable amino acids.
black tea reduces the true IAA (essential amino acid) digestibility of hens’ egg in healthy adult humans.
